subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.summary: Review Premium terms, billing timing, cancellation, refunds, and device rules.

subscription.taxes: Applicable taxes are shown before confirmation

invoices.summary: Review charges, payment method, billing period, and the status of each invoice.
invoices.caption: Invoice history

device.title: Device
device.summary: Review the current device details and the 30-day replacement cooldown.
device.label: My primary PC
device.detail: Windows 11 · protected identity · raw HWID is never stored
device.cooldown: You can transfer or reset the active PC every 30 days. Reinstalls and minor upgrades do not consume a reset; major hardware changes may require a new activation.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.summary: Stable releases remain public and never require an account.
downloads.boundary: This link opens the public release surface. No session, account context, or form data crosses origins.

privacy.title: Privacy center
privacy.summary: Review the privacy requests available for this account without submitting one.
privacy.purpose: Choose export, correction, consent, or deletion and review what the request would cover.
privacy.retention: Request details remain only for the current review and are cleared when you leave it.
privacy.sharing: Nothing is uploaded, sent, or shared.
privacy.revocation: Cancel at any time. The review closes and no account data changes.

support.title: Support
support.summary: Prepare a support request and review its contents before anything is sent.
support.purpose: Prepare a support request for explicit review.
support.retention: The draft is discarded if you leave before confirmation.
support.sharing: No diagnostic, attachment, email, or account record is shared.
support.revocation: Cancel the review at any point; nothing has been submitted.
support.noUpload: Diagnostics can be attached only with explicit consent for this request.
support.sensitiveReview: Remove credentials, payment data, recovery codes, and unrelated personal information before any future submission.
